article_content: Amazon is poised to enter the competitive streaming device market later this year with a new set-top box.  This move pits them against established broadcasters, as well as potential offerings from tech giants like Apple and Intel.  The device will seamlessly integrate with Amazon's current video platforms: Amazon Video on Demand in the US and Lovefilm in the UK.  Bloomberg reports that the project, spearheaded by Amazon's Lab126 division in Cupertino (near Apple's headquarters), is being led by Malachy Moynihan, formerly of Cisco and Apple.  This development coincides with Amazon's increased investment in original content.  After recently releasing 14 pilot episodes, Amazon is leveraging viewer feedback to greenlight full series.  One such pilot, 'Alpha House,' features John Goodman (known for 'The Big Lebowski' and 'Argo') and Bill Murray ('Ghostbusters,' 'Groundhog Day').  Roy Price, director of Amazon Studios, believes the lines between traditional and online television are blurring, emphasizing the importance of customer input in content creation.  Each pilot is freely accessible on Amazon Instant Video and Lovefilm.  In addition to original programming, Amazon has secured exclusive streaming rights to popular shows like 'Downton Abbey.'

Uređaj će se neprimjetno integrirati s Amazonovim trenutnim video platformama: Amazon Video on Demand u SAD-u i Lovefilm u Velikoj Britaniji. Bloomberg izvještava da projekt, koji predvodi Amazonov odjel Lab126 u Cupertinu (blizu Appleovog sjedišta), vodi Malachy Moynihan, bivši zaposlenik Cisca i Applea. Ovaj razvoj događaja podudara se s Amazonovim povećanim ulaganjem u originalni sadržaj. Nakon što je nedavno objavio 14 pilot epizoda, Amazon koristi povratne informacije gledatelja kako bi odobrio snimanje punih sezona. article_content: 'Due to an organizational mistake, approximately 5,000 participants in last month's Marathon of the North in Sunderland inadvertently ran a slightly shorter route. A marshalling error near the Stadium of Light led runners 264 meters off course. Although the lead runner, Mark Hood, who ultimately won the half-marathon, stayed on track, the majority of runners, including those participating in both the half and full marathons, were misdirected. This resulted in them falling short of the official race distances. Race organizers have issued an apology, taking full responsibility for the mishap, and are offering affected runners a 25% discount on future events. They've stated their hope that this incident won't deter future participation.'

Pogreška u usmjeravanju trkača blizu stadiona Svjetlosti skrenula je trkače 264 metra s kursa. Iako je vodeći trkač, Mark Hood, koji je na kraju pobijedio u polumaratonu, ostao na pravom putu, većina trkača, uključujući i one koji su sudjelovali u polumaratonu i maratonu, bila je krivo usmjerena. article_content: Residents of Minneapolis and St. Paul have observed numerous low-flying black helicopters involved in training exercises. These helicopters, identified as the 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment (also known as 'Night Stalkers'), are operating under the Department of Defense.  While the DoD has issued an apology for any disturbance caused, the specific objective of these exercises remains undisclosed.  The Night Stalkers are known for their specialized support of teams like the Navy SEALS, emphasizing secrecy and precision in their missions, according to their website. This lack of transparency has sparked public concern, with some residents questioning the necessity and financial justification for such operations within urban areas.  Daniel Feidt, a Minneapolis resident, voiced his disapproval to CBS Minnesota, citing concerns about the scale of these domestic military exercises and their impact on taxpayers.  Similar sentiments were echoed by St. Paul City Council member Chris Tolbert, who expressed outrage to the Pioneer Press regarding the lack of prior notification, particularly given the disturbance caused by low-flying aircraft. While local law enforcement confirmed that the exercises were planned in advance, security concerns prevented them from disclosing specific times and locations.  They characterized the training as routine, emphasizing the importance of pilots adapting to unfamiliar environments.

Iako se Ministarstvo obrane ispričalo za eventualne smetnje, specifični cilj ovih vježbi ostaje nepoznat. Night Stalkers su poznati po svojoj specijaliziranoj podršci timovima poput Navy SEALs-a, naglašavajući tajnost i preciznost u svojim misijama, prema njihovoj web stranici. Taj nedostatak transparentnosti izazvao je zabrinutost javnosti, a neki stanovnici dovode u pitanje nužnost i financijsko opravdanje za takve operacije u urbanim područjima. Daniel Feidt, stanovnik Minneapolisa, izrazio je svoje neodobravanje CBS Minnesoti, navodeći zabrinutost zbog opsega ovih domaćih vojnih vježbi i njihovog utjecaja na porezne obveznike. Dok je lokalna policija potvrdila da su vježbe planirane unaprijed, sigurnosni razlozi spriječili su ih da otkriju točna vremena i lokacije. Ocijenili su obuku rutinskom, naglašavajući važnost prilagodbe pilota nepoznatim okruženjima.

article_content: Faced with budget challenges, the Pennsbury School District in Pennsylvania has devised a creative solution: in-school advertising.  Soon, over 200 ads, measuring up to 5ft by 10ft, will appear across sixteen of the district's primary, middle, and high schools.  This initiative is projected to generate as much as $424,000 in revenue.  The ads, placed on walls, floors, lockers, benches, and even lunch tables, will focus on topics like health, education, nutrition, and student safety.  Partnering with a national marketing agency, the district has stipulated that advertisements cannot directly promote products but can highlight areas like outdoor activities and concussion awareness.  According to the Philadelphia Inquirer, Assistant Superintendent W. David Bowman emphasized the need for alternative funding sources to preserve existing educational programs and avoid increasing class sizes.  Companies like the U.S. Library of Congress, Post-it Notes, and Dick’s Sporting Goods are among those expected to advertise in the schools.  The Minneapolis-based firm School Media, which brokered the deal, already has similar agreements with nine other districts in Minnesota and California. This move mirrors a similar trend in New Jersey, where school bus advertising will soon be permitted.

Uskoro će se više od 200 oglasa, veličine do 1.5m x 3m, pojaviti u šesnaest okružnih osnovnih, srednjih i visokih škola. Ova inicijativa trebala bi generirati čak 424.000 dolara prihoda. Oglasi, postavljeni na zidovima, podovima, ormarićima, klupama, pa čak i stolovima u blagovaonicama, bit će usmjereni na teme poput zdravlja, obrazovanja, prehrane i sigurnosti učenika. U partnerstvu s nacionalnom marketinškom agencijom, okrug je odredio da oglasi ne smiju izravno promovirati proizvode, već mogu isticati područja poput aktivnosti na otvorenom i osvješćivanja o potresu mozga. Prema Philadelphia Inquireru, pomoćnik ravnatelja W. David Bowman naglasio je potrebu za alternativnim izvorima financiranja kako bi se očuvali postojeći obrazovni programi i izbjeglo povećanje broja učenika u razredima. Među tvrtkama koje će se oglašavati u školama su Američki Kongresna knjižnica, Post-it Notes i Dick’s Sporting Goods. Tvrtka School Media sa sjedištem u Minneapolisu, koja je posredovala u dogovoru, već ima slične sporazume s devet drugih okruga u Minnesoti i Kaliforniji. Ovaj potez odražava sličan trend u New Jerseyju, gdje će uskoro biti dopušteno oglašavanje na školskim autobusima.

article_content: 'Raging forest fires in Indonesia blanketed Singapore and Malaysia with thick smoke, causing a public health emergency in 2013. Indonesian President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono issued a formal apology, taking responsibility for the crisis and promising immediate action.  The smoke, a result of land-clearing for palm oil plantations, led to hazardous air quality levels in Malaysia, forcing school closures and a state of emergency in Johor state. Singapore experienced its worst smog since 1997, impacting daily life. Thousands of firefighters and additional resources were deployed to combat the fires on Sumatra island. An investigation is underway to determine the companies responsible, with potential legal action from Singapore against those involved.'
translated_content: 'Bijesni šumski požari u Indoneziji prekrili su Singapur i Maleziju gustim dimom, uzrokujući izvanredno stanje javnog zdravlja 2013. Indonezijski predsjednik Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono uputio je službenu ispriku, preuzimajući odgovornost za krizu i obećavajući hitne mjere. Dim, posljedica krčenja zemljišta za plantaže palminog ulja, doveo je do opasnih razina kvalitete zraka u Maleziji, prisiljavajući zatvaranje škola i proglašenje izvanrednog stanja u državi Johor. Singapur je doživio najgori smog od 1997., što je utjecalo na svakodnevni život. Tisuće vatrogasaca i dodatni resursi raspoređeni su u borbu protiv požara na otoku Sumatri. U tijeku je istraga kako bi se utvrdilo koje su tvrtke odgovorne, a Singapur bi mogao poduzeti pravne mjere protiv uključenih.'

article_content: Nine-year-old Daisy Pritchard, sitting tall and proud on her pony, Dollar, paints a picture of resilience. At just 21 months old, Daisy suffered a stroke during heart surgery, leading doctors to believe she'd never walk or talk again.  Her extraordinary recovery is largely thanks to the unique bond she shares with Dollar. Their connection began when Daisy, nearly three and still using a wheelchair, visited the stables. Dollar approached her, and a silent understanding passed between them.  It was the first time Daisy had moved her head since the stroke, a moment her mother, Eileen, describes as seeing 'a spark of the child I'd lost.'  Eileen began holding Daisy on Dollar's saddle, initially for back physiotherapy. The riding sessions, where Daisy held the reins with her left hand, proved more effective than traditional exercises for her stroke-induced paralysis and twisted back.  By age five, Daisy could walk short distances. Her mother, from Wrexham, Wales, explains that Dollar 'became her legs, her reason to get up and walk.'  Daisy's journey began in 2006, following several rounds of IVF for her parents, Eileen and David.  In 2008, tests revealed Daisy had a heart defect requiring surgery. Complications during the first operation led to a second, during which she had the stroke.  Today, Daisy attends mainstream school, walks, talks, and even has a unique way of communicating with Dollar, tapping his neck to signal turns. Though she still uses a wheelchair or scooter outside, on Dollar, she rides unaided. 'Without Dollar,' Eileen says, 'I don't believe Daisy would have ever recovered.'  Dollar's gentle nature with Daisy contrasts his usual boisterousness, taking smaller steps and ensuring her stability. Their bond is a testament to the healing power of connection.

Sa samo 21 mjesec, Daisy je pretrpjela moždani udar tijekom operacije srca, zbog čega su liječnici vjerovali da nikada neće hodati ni govoriti. Njen izvanredan oporavak uvelike je zahvaljujući jedinstvenoj vezi koju dijeli s Dollarom. Njihova povezanost započela je kada je Daisy, s gotovo tri godine i još uvijek u invalidskim kolicima, posjetila staje. Dollar joj je prišao i među njima se stvorilo tiho razumijevanje. To je bio prvi put da je Daisy pomaknula glavu od moždanog udara, trenutak koji njezina majka Eileen opisuje kao 'iskru djeteta kojeg sam izgubila'. Eileen je počela držati Daisy na Dollarovom sedlu, isprva zbog fizikalne terapije za leđa. Sejacije jahanja, gdje je Daisy držala uzde lijevom rukom, pokazale su se učinkovitijima od tradicionalnih vježbi za paralizu i iskrivljena leđa uzrokovana moždanim udarom. S pet godina Daisy je mogla hodati kratke udaljenosti. Njezina majka, iz Wrexhama u Walesu, objašnjava da je Dollar 'postao njezine noge, njezin razlog da ustane i hoda'. Daisyino putovanje započelo je 2006. godine, nakon nekoliko rundi IVF-a za njezine roditelje, Eileen i Davida. Godine 2008. testovi su otkrili da Daisy ima srčanu manu koja zahtijeva operaciju. Komplikacije tijekom prve operacije dovele su do druge, tijekom koje je doživjela moždani udar. Danas Daisy pohađa redovnu školu, hoda, govori, pa čak i ima jedinstven način komunikacije s Dollarom, tapkajući ga po vratu kako bi signalizirala skretanje. Iako još uvijek koristi invalidska kolica ili skuter vani, na Dollaru jaše bez pomoći. 'Bez Dollara', kaže Eileen, 'ne vjerujem da bi se Daisy ikada oporavila'. article_content: 'Increasing numbers of teachers are taking early retirement due to excessive workload and the stress of Ofsted inspections, according to Christine Blower, secretary of the National Union of Teachers.  Figures reveal almost 9,000 teachers left the profession before the statutory retirement age last year, the highest number since 1997.  Teachers' leaders cite the challenges of managing student behavior, pressure from performance targets, and Ofsted inspections as key reasons.  Additional factors include pay freezes and increased pension contributions.  Data from the Department for Education indicates over 230,000 qualified teachers under 60 are no longer in schools, with a further 80,700 trained individuals never entering the profession. This teacher shortage looms as school rolls are projected to rise.  While the teachers' pension age is 65, those employed before 2007 can retire at 60.  Approximately 8,880 state school teachers opted for early retirement in 2010/11, a significant increase from previous years. The average annual pension for these early retirees was £15,000, excluding lump sums.  Blower highlighted 'excessive workload, a restrictive curriculum, and the intense pressure of Ofsted inspections' as major contributors to early retirement.  She also criticized the 'almost daily attacks' from the government and Ofsted.  Teaching unions are currently in dispute with the government over pension reforms.  Chris McGovern, chairman of the Campaign for Real Education, acknowledged the difficulties of teaching disaffected students and implementing an irrelevant curriculum. The Department for Education stated that teachers have the right to retire early and highlighted reforms aimed at improving teacher retention.'

Podaci pokazuju da je gotovo 9.000 nastavnika napustilo zvanje prije zakonski propisane mirovinske dobi prošle godine, što je najveći broj od 1997.  Predstavnici učitelja kao ključne razloge navode izazove u nošenju s ponašanjem učenika, pritisak koji stvaraju ciljevi učinka i Ofstedove inspekcije.  Dodatni čimbenici uključuju zamrzavanje plaća i povećanje mirovinskih doprinosa.  Podaci Ministarstva obrazovanja pokazuju da preko 230.000 kvalificiranih nastavnika mlađih od 60 godina više ne radi u školama, uz dodatnih 80.700 osoba koje su se školovale za nastavnike, ali nikad nisu počele raditi u učionici. Ovaj nedostatak nastavnika prijeti u trenutku kada se očekuje porast broja učenika.  Dok je mirovinska dob za nastavnike 65 godina, oni zaposleni prije 2007. mogu se umiroviti s 60 godina.  Oko 8.880 nastavnika u državnim školama odlučilo se za prijevremenu mirovinu u školskoj godini 2010./11., što je značajno povećanje u odnosu na prethodne godine. Prosječna godišnja mirovina za ove prijevremeno umirovljene iznosila je 15.000 funti, ne uključujući otpremnine.  Blower je istaknula 'prekomjerno opterećenje, restriktivan kurikulum i snažan pritisak Ofstedovih inspekcija' kao glavne čimbenike prijevremenog umirovljenja.  Također je kritizirala 'gotovo svakodnevne napade' vlade i Ofsteda.  Učiteljski sindikati trenutno su u sporu s vladom oko mirovinskih reformi.  Chris McGovern, predsjednik Kampanje za stvarno obrazovanje, prepoznao je poteškoće u podučavanju nezadovoljne djece i primjeni neadekvatnog kurikuluma. Ministarstvo obrazovanja izjavilo je da nastavnici imaju pravo na prijevremenu mirovinu i istaknulo je reforme usmjerene na poboljšanje zadržavanja nastavnika u zvanju.'

article_content: 'Nineteen-year-old Max Wade received a 21-year prison sentence for the attempted murder of a young couple and the theft of celebrity chef Guy Fieri's Lamborghini.  In 2011, Wade orchestrated a daring heist of Fieri's $200,000 convertible from British Motors dealership, hoping to win over 17-year-old Eva Dedier.  Rejected by Dedier, Wade subsequently targeted her and her new boyfriend, Landon Wahlstrom, in a drive-by shooting a year later.  The stolen vehicle was eventually located in a Richmond storage unit belonging to Wade, along with other weapons and climbing gear.  Fieri testified, confirming he had no prior connection to Wade and never authorized the car's use. Wade, tried as an adult for the crimes committed while underage, pleaded not guilty to all charges.  The prosecution emphasized Wade's motivation to impress Dedier with the stolen car and his willingness to resort to violence after being rejected.  Fieri expressed relief at the case's conclusion, remarking on the bizarre nature of the events.'

Wade je organizirao smjelu krađu Fierijevog kabrioleta vrijednog 200.000 dolara iz prodajnog salona British Motors, nadajući se da će osvojiti 17-godišnju Evu Dedier.  Nakon što ga je Dedier odbila, Wade je godinu dana kasnije pokušao ubiti nju i njenog novog dečka, Landona Wahlstroma, u pucnjavi iz automobila.  Ukradeno vozilo je na kraju pronađeno u skladištu u Richmondu koje pripada Wadeu, zajedno s drugim oružjem i opremom za penjanje.  Fieri je svjedočio, potvrđujući da nije imao nikakve veze s Wadeom i da nikada nije odobrio korištenje automobila. Wade, koji je suđen kao odrasla osoba za zločine počinjene dok je bio maloljetan, izjasnio se da nije kriv ni po jednoj točki optužnice.  Tužiteljstvo je naglasilo Wadeovu motivaciju da impresionira Dedier ukradenim automobilom i njegovu spremnost na nasilje nakon što je odbijen.  Fieri je izrazio olakšanje zbog završetka slučaja, komentirajući bizarnu prirodu događaja.'
